accounts_empty_hint: Add one to sign in to another Claude account.
claude_missing_body: Install Claude Desktop, then reopen clawshell.
delete_body: This deletes the account's sign-in, settings and data from this PC. This can't be undone.
missing_hint: Its folder was deleted outside clawshell.
missing_body: Its folder is already gone. This removes the account from the list.
shortcuts_added: Shortcuts added to the Desktop and Start menu
usage_empty_hint: Sign in to an account on the Accounts tab to see your combined usage.
cost_prices_unavailable: Couldn't fetch model prices, so there is no Code-tab estimate. Check your connection and refresh.
cost_unpriced: {count} messages use models without a known price and are left out.
heatmap_no_prices: No dollar estimate: model prices could not be fetched.
settings_start_hidden_hint: When Windows starts it, stay in the tray instead of showing the window.
settings_close_to_tray_hint: The close button hides clawshell to the tray. Off, it quits.
settings_claude_path_hint: Only used when clawshell can't find Claude Desktop itself.
error_settings_autostart: Couldn't change whether clawshell starts with Windows
error_claude_path_not_a_file: That path is a folder, not a file.
settings_notify_warning_hint: Notify when an account reaches the warning threshold.
settings_notify_limited_hint: Notify when an account reaches the limit threshold.
settings_notify_reset_hint: Notify when an account's 5-hour or weekly window resets.
settings_thresholds_hint: Each alert fires once per window, for the 5-hour and weekly limits alike.
error_thresholds_invalid: The warning must be below the limit, and both between 1 and 100.
launch_options_env_hint: Set for this account's Claude only.
launch_options_flags_hint: One flag per row, passed as written. Example: --lang=fa
launch_options_note: Changes apply only when this account's Claude starts fresh. A copy that is already running keeps its old settings until you close it and open it again.
error_env_name_invalid: Variable names can use letters, digits and underscore only, and must not start with a digit.
error_env_name_duplicate: A variable name is used twice.
error_env_value_invalid: A value can not hold a NUL character.
error_flag_reserved: --user-data-dir is set by clawshell and can not be changed.
error_launch_options_failed: Couldn't save the environment and flags
settings_sign_in_routing_hint: Send browser sign-ins to the account that asked for them. Off puts Claude's own link handling back.
routing_default_apps_body: Windows opened Default Apps. Under clawshell, set the claude link type to clawshell.
routing_choice_body: Windows sends claude links to another app. In Default Apps, set the claude link type to clawshell.
routing_offer_title: Route browser sign-ins to the right account?
routing_offer_body: When a sign-in finishes in your browser, clawshell sends it to the account you were signing in to, not your original Claude. You can change this later in Settings.
update_failed_detail: Your current version is still running. Check your connection and try again.
